rationale: REGN gapped up ~6% on strong earnings beat and is trading at 81.5% of its intraday range near session highs, but with only 57 minutes to close and a broad market under significant stress (SPY -2.31%, VIXY +14.83%), the risk of a late-session reversal pulling this extended name lower is substantial. The stock is already well above VWAP ($911) and the 9-EMA ($914.87), offering limited upside to the day's high ($935.35) relative to the downside risk, while a short against a strong earnings catalyst in a high-volatility environment carries equal uncertainty. The risk/reward in either direction does not justify committing capital this late in the session.
